title: Tincture signed blazon bundle
description: The signed bundle a runtime loads (docs/spec/06-blazon.md section 7): a compiled blazon and the signatures over it. Structural validity only. Each signature is over "TNCT/1/blazon" || 0x00 || JCS(blazon); the bundle's own layout and member order are not signed. A loader additionally refuses repeated member names and numbers that are not non-negative integers below 2^53, which JSON Schema cannot express.

signer.description: The id of a key in the currently trusted signer set. Entries by other signers are ignored.

suite.description: The signature suite, as a registry ID ("0x0301", the form signers write) or a registry name ("ED25519"). It must be the suite of the signer's trusted key, or the entry does not count.

sig.description: The signature, base64url without padding. 0x0301: 64 bytes (RFC 8032). 0x0302: 64 bytes, r || s, each 32 bytes big-endian.
